proved_scoped: For every finite variable set C with |C| >= 3, the conjunction of all clauses (not c_i OR not c_j OR not c_k) over distinct triples is exactly equivalent to SUM(C) <= 2.
The explicit complete negative 3-uniform Horn family is recognizable in polynomial time in its explicit input size by exact triple census.
The recognized family compiles to an exact proof-carrying AT_MOST_2 carrier using O(n) variable entries instead of literal branching depth n.
C023/C034 NEQ source/falsity pairs are independently verified before the morph is authorized.
